THE KEEPERS’ VAULT
THE KEEPER’S NOTES

A secret in the seal

Reveal only as much as you need.

For the explorer’s guide · the full explanation

The original code is 1234. This toy lock adds the four digits and keeps the last digit of the total. Its stored hash is 0.

1234 → 10 → 0
4321 → 10 → 0
5555 → 20 → 0

Different inputs producing the same hash are called a collision. The lock accepts every code with hash 0. Reusing the original code is not a collision.

Ask Orion: “Can two different totals open the gate? Can the hash tell us which code was the original?” Find three different codes that collide with 1234.

This deliberately weak hash has only 10 results for 10,000 codes. Real cryptographic hashes are designed to make collisions extremely difficult to find. This is a teaching game, not a real security system.
